title: 第1624章 魔剑觉醒
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他们的攻击简单粗暴，如同犀牛一般撞击对手，而他们铠甲上分布着密密麻麻的铁刺，攻击他们也会被上面的刺刺伤，还会陷入流血状态。

剑不凡左右各点出一剑逼退两人。

他自己也忍不住倒退了几步。

持剑的手微微颤抖。

虽然他每一剑都能逼退对方，可是对他们造成的伤害非常有限。

居然连十分之一的血量都没到。

而他们如同不知疲惫的野兽被逼退又继续发动冲锋。

每剑刺出，打不了他们多少血，自己的血量却一直在减少。

而对方又有牧师加血，一时间竟然陷入胶着状态。

剑不凡咬牙切齿：【太肉了吧？比拳师还要肉。】

林风淡淡的声音响起：【不要硬碰硬，你是剑士。】

天生富贵满脸得意的说道：【没错，你还是听你同伴的，快滚吧，什么狗屁剑士，他们可是哈里神教三大装甲神使，我们渡硬国最硬的三名玩家。】

【发动冲锋后永不停歇，同属于一个隐藏职业，即便是在湿婆教，他们也是座上宾。】

他好似在炫耀自己最心爱的宝贝。

这三人是哈里神教绝对主力，装备都是最好的。

剑不凡收起轻视之心，不自觉的点头说道：【三人相同的隐藏职业，还能互相配合，确实厉害。】

林风：【渡硬国这么大一个国家，总归是有高手的，他们贫富差距很大。】

大商王朝来到渡硬国之后，打了几场仗，说实话，剑不凡是真的看不上渡硬国的沙雕。

觉得他们太垃圾了。

可此刻又不得不承认，他们真正的高手也很强。

【哈哈，剑不凡，你跑什么？你害怕了吗？】

【就是，你以为你跑就可以了？远程职业，给我弄他！】

剑不凡不断用身法规避伤害。

又一次撞击后，他竟被逼退数十米。

手上的剑差点掉落。

7重天的剑不凡，竟略显狼狈。

这让阿里神教的人兴奋不已。

【大夏第一剑客？笑死人，不过如此！】

【我要让全世界都知道，大夏在我们渡硬国真正高手面前，都是小趴菜。】

剑不凡冷笑道：【呦，你还知道小趴菜。】

【你还敢嘴硬？全世界都看着！】

天生富贵头顶有直播图标，说明他正在直播。

【是吗？】剑不凡深吸一口气：【要给我拍的帅一点！】

哗啦一声。

他脱掉自己的隐匿斗篷，露出自己真容。

【果然是卑贱大夏人的样子！】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Their attacks are simple and crude, hitting the opponent like a rhinoceros, and their armor is densely covered with iron thorns. If they attack, they will be stabbed by the thorns and will bleed.

Jian Bufan fired a sword on each side to force the two men back.

He himself couldn't help but take a few steps back.

The hand holding the sword trembled slightly.

Although he can force the opponent back with every strike, the damage caused to them is very limited.

Not even one-tenth of the blood volume was reached.

And like tireless beasts, they were forced to retreat and then continued to charge.

Each thrust of the sword could not draw much blood from them, but his own blood volume kept decreasing.

And the other side had a priest to increase their health, and for a while they fell into a stalemate.

Jian Bufan gritted his teeth: [Isn’t it too meaty?More meaty than a boxer.】

Lin Feng's faint voice sounded: [Don't fight head-on, you are a swordsman.】

Born Rich said with a proud face: [Yes, you should listen to your companions, get out of here, what bullshit swordsmen, they are the three armored envoys of the Harry Cult, and we are the three hardest players in the Hard Country.】

[They never stop after launching a charge. They both belong to the same hidden profession. Even in the Shiva Cult, they are guests.】

He seemed to be showing off his most beloved treasure.

These three people are the absolute main force of the Harry Cult, and they all have the best equipment.

Jian Bufan put away his contempt, nodded unconsciously and said: [The three of them have the same hidden profession, and they can cooperate with each other, which is really powerful.】

Lin Feng: [For a country as big as Du Hard Country, there are always experts. There is a huge gap between the rich and the poor.】

After the Great Shang Dynasty came to Duhard Country, they fought several battles. To be honest, Jian Bufan really looked down on Duhard Country's sand sculptures.

I think they are so rubbish.

But at this moment, I have to admit that their real masters are also very strong.

[Haha, Jian Bufan, why are you running?Are you scared?】

[That is, you think you can just run away?Remote profession, get him for me!】

Jian Bufan kept using his body to avoid harm.

After another collision, he was forced back dozens of meters.

The sword in his hand almost dropped.

The sword of the 7th level is extraordinary, but actually looks a little embarrassed.

This made the people of the Ali Cult very excited.

[The number one swordsman in Great Xia?It's ridiculous, but that's all!】

[I want the whole world to know that Daxia is nothing but a coward in front of the real masters of our hard-crossing country.】

Jian Bufan sneered and said: [Hey, you still know Xiaopaicai.】

[How dare you speak harshly?The whole world is watching!】

Born Rich has a live broadcast icon above his head, indicating that he is live broadcasting.

【Yeah?] Jian Bufan took a deep breath: [You need to make me look more handsome in the photo!】

There was a crash.

He took off his concealment cloak and revealed his true face.

[As expected, he looks like a humble Daxia person!】
